name: Cold Sweat
tagline: Neon wireframe in the dark, and blocks that lie to you.

facts.note: Known for its fake blocks, placed to mislead the player.

theme.mood: Cold and clinical. White wireframe geometry receding into black, hard scanlines across everything, chromatic split on the type, and one rainbow prism beam cutting the frame diagonally.

voice.hook: The one that lies to you.
voice.why:
Cold Sweat earns its place on nerve. The fake blocks are the whole thesis — a level that decorates itself with things that look solid and aren't, so you spend the run doubting what you're seeing. That is a genuinely mean idea, executed cleanly.

And it looks incredible doing it. White wireframe against near-black, scanlines, that one prism streak. It's the coldest-looking level on this list and the name fits perfectly.
